goal: Allow PSBTs with valid Taproot signatures to be signed or finalized when no sighash type is specified
Prevent wallet failures where valid PSBTs are rejected with a sighash mismatch error
agreement: Support for permitting 65-byte Taproot signatures without explicit sighash types (Husteem)
Concerns about sighash handling and requests for functional tests were addressed (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a bug blocking completion of valid PSBT signing and finalization workflows
Users handling valid PSBTs with 65-byte Taproot signatures will no longer experience failed signings
